svg.font-family: Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Every source preset by wavelength
svg.desc: Every source preset placed on a log-wavelength ruler from 500 to 0.05 nm with a glyph for how its wavelength is set, the family's grade chip, spans for the X-ray tube and the betatron, and the optics regime bands beneath.
